description: Aggregate and tally unique values for any field across any openFDA endpoint. Returns ranked term-count pairs sorted by count descending; a date field tallies one term per distinct YYYYMMDD date, ranked the same way. Pair with openfda_search_adverse_events, openfda_search_drug_approvals, openfda_search_device_clearances, openfda_search_recalls, openfda_get_drug_label, or openfda_lookup_ndc when sample records help interpret the aggregates.

count.description: Field to count. openfda_describe_fields gives the verified expression per field as countAs (null = not countable in any form). Otherwise: append .exact for whole-phrase counting of free-text fields (e.g. "patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact"); count identifier fields openFDA already indexes as keywords (product_ndc, application_number, pma_number) bare — .exact on those is rejected as not countable. A date field (receivedate, report_date, decision_date) is counted bare and yields one term per distinct YYYYMMDD date.

limit.description: Number of top terms to return. truncated reports whether more distinct terms exist beyond it, except at 1000 — openFDA's own count maximum — where openFDA offers no way to tell. A date field is the exception: openFDA sends every date, so the tool ranks them all and truncated is exact at any limit; scope search to at most limit dates to list each one. Default 100; a larger value returns at most 1000 and says so.

search.description: Filter query to scope the count (e.g. patient.drug.medicinalproduct:"metformin"). Omit to count across every record in the endpoint. A "+" between clauses reads as a space; inside a quoted phrase it is a literal plus.

name: openfda_count_values

cap.description: The limit applied to the term list.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: The openFDA daily or per-minute request limit is exceeded. `upstream_error`: The openFDA API returned a 5xx server error. `malformed_search`: search leaves a double quote, parenthesis, or range bracket unclosed, ends on a backslash, or holds a character openFDA refuses. `query_error`: The search or count query was rejected by openFDA (malformed field name, invalid syntax). `not_aggregatable`: openFDA cannot aggregate the count expression as written — an analyzed text field, .exact on a field already indexed as a keyword, or a field with no countable form. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for this tally: why it is empty and how to widen it, how to reach terms past limit, the 1000-term maximum, count rows left out, limit clamp, SQL for AND-ed clauses on one array entry. Absent when nothing needs saying.

results.description: Term-count pairs sorted by count descending

term.description: Field value; on a date field, the date as YYYYMMDD

shown.description: Number of terms returned in this response.

truncated.description: True when at least one more distinct term exists beyond the limit. Absent when the list is complete, and at the 1000-term maximum, where openFDA cannot show whether more exist (notice says so). Exact at any limit on a date field, where every date arrives.

truncationCeiling.description: Count of the lowest-ranked term returned — omitted terms fall at or below it.

title: Openfda Count Values
